decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that records the selected OPSCO SK6812MINI-E part, LCSC C5149201, and RGBW format; no additional interface-state change or stale key is entailed.
The selected LED part does not change the ESP32-S3 module model or its LCSC part number.
The LED component selection is unrelated to the battery connector family, pinout, and part number.
The source identifies an LED package and part but does not change the standalone USB regulator, powered 3.3V rail, or source-selection behavior.
The exact LED part does not alter the sensor-board connector fanout or its listed external modules.
LCSC C5149201 is an LED part and does not change the selected USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
Selecting the exact SK6812MINI-E component leaves the established charge-status display method, GPIO, and dedicated charge-LED circuit unchanged.
The source selects an LED component but does not modify the candidate's BOM-readiness obligations concerning capacitor part numbers or justification of unplanned components.
The source does not specify LED power routing and therefore does not change the boost converter enable control, GPIO, or current powered-load list.
The LED part selection has no effect on USB data lines or the USB-C programming-port role.
The selected LED component does not change the SPS30 connector, supply, I2C signals, or SEL connection.
The source gives no rail-voltage or DCDC1 decision and therefore leaves the 3.3V regulation requirement unchanged.
